name: standalone-muted-digital-audio-clock-probe
physical_policy: All specified IOs use existing audited 3.3V locations; output DRIVE=4. No sslow/sd/slow outputs, USB, HDMI, DDR or CPU in this probe. Physical SMUTE is permanently asserted; PCM is zero.
sequence: Boot48k epoch0, hold50ms, switch44.1k epoch1, hold50ms, switch48k epoch2, hold50ms, COMPLETE. Any fault/reject/failure latches ERROR; external restart repeats the experiment.
snapshot_policy: Selected-MCLK registers and holds all192 payload bits before ACK; two50MHz payload registers and two ACK registers precede destination capture. Destination issues no further request until capture. Flush resets both transport ends and invalidates snapshots. Decoder must require snapshot_valid and !flush. GAO sees only registered50MHz debug words.

sdc_capability.manual: doc/EN/SUG940-2.0.1E_Gowin Design Timing Constraints User Guide.pdf
sdc_capability.dual_master_generated_clock: Documented PDF66-69: -source, -master_clock and -add; targets support get_pins.
sdc_capability.selected_clock_exclusivity: PDF78-79 supports precise set_false_path clock endpoints. Only selected48->selected44 and reverse are impossible. The SDK group form suppressed CDC max-delay report paths in B3/B4, so it is not used.
sdc_capability.unknown_sdk_policy: Prepare records an explicit blocker and build refuses if the checked manual is missing or different. Never substitute a combinational mux or broad audio-domain false path.

retirement: Experimental digital-only probe. Retire as an integration input after the complete workstation output-paced bridge, dual-rate DSP/final-PCM path, routed gates and board acceptance pass; retain evidence and reusable regression. It must never become a production source profile.
